377:t_1:87.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$ティティ$$ is attached to $n. You have no choice but to take command.」

377:t_1:88.en:
$$甲児$$
「First, keep her from doing anything unnecessary. The damage $c's suffered these three days is no joke.」

377:t_1:89.en:
$$さやか$$
「On day one, she tried to paint every unit's right shoulder red...」

377:t_1:90.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Don't you think having everyone be $$レッドショルダー$$s would be a great bluff?」

377:t_1:91.en:
$$ティティ$$
「I actually wanted to make them all $$シャア$$ customs, but there wasn't enough paint.」

377:t_1:93.en:
$$アマタ$$
「On day two, she tried putting flower and $$ハロ$$ patches on everyone's pilot suits...」

377:t_1:94.en:
$$ティティ$$
「I picked a design that suited each person, you know.」

377:t_1:95.en:
$$カレン$$
「So that's why you put a red ogre patch on my suit!?」

377:t_1:97.en:
$$ティティ$$
「...It seems nobody enjoyed it...」

377:t_1:99.en:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Honestly...! How were you raised? I'd like to meet your parents!」

377:t_1:102.en:
$$ティティ$$
「...My dad and big brother died in the $$時空震動$$, so...」

377:t_1:104.en:
$$ティティ$$
「After that, Mom wasn't herself anymore... It seemed... she'd stopped loving me...」

377:t_1:106.en:
$$ティティ$$
「So I... didn't want to start hating Mom... That's why I left home, but...」

377:t_1:107.en:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「I-I'm sorry, $$ティティ$$... I... didn't know you'd been through all that.」

377:t_1:108.en:
$$ティティ$$
「It's okay. I'm... having fun now.」

377:t_1:109.en:
$$谷川$$
「Okay, I understand! In that case, the housekeeping crew will look after $$ティティ$$.」

377:t_1:110.en:
$$中原$$
「Even $$ノノ$$, who breaks everything, is a pretty good help now. I'm sure you'll get the hang of it too, $$ティティ$$.」

377:t_1:111.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Thank you! I'll do my best!」

377:t_1:113.en:
$$宗介$$
「She lost a parent in the $$時空震動$$ too...」

377:t_1:115.en:
$$カレン$$
「Do you feel sorry for her?」

377:t_1:117.en:
$n
(I feel calmer around her because I sensed something in her that was like me...?)

377:t_1:118.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Excuse me! Has anyone seen my $$Ｖコン$$!?」

377:t_1:119.en:
$$宗介$$
「You mean the controller for $$鉄人$$?」

377:t_1:125.en:
$$ティティ$$
「...That's the thing that looks like a metal briefcase, right?」

377:t_1:126.en:
$n
「Do you know where it is, $$ティティ$$?」

377:t_1:127.en:
$$ティティ$$
「While I was cleaning $$正太郎$$'s room, someone came and asked to borrow it, so I gave it to them.」

377:t_1:128.en:
$$正太郎$$
「You gave it away...? To who!?」

377:t_1:129.en:
$$ティティ$$
「It was someone I didn't know.」

377:t_1:130.en:
$$葵$$
「That impact...! It's coming from the hangar!」

377:t_1:137.en:
$$セイミー$$
「$$鉄人$$ suddenly started going wild...」

377:t_1:139.en:
$$セイミー$$
「$$オックス$$ tried to stop it, but it broke through the hangar doors and left.」

377:t_1:140.en:
$n
「Is someone using the $$Ｖコン$$ to control $$鉄人$$!?」

377:t_2:3.en:
???
「Heh heh heh... Your weakness is that you cannot abandon $$鉄人$$ or this city and flee.」

377:t_2:4.en:
???
「Only the strong survive in space... Humanity cannot understand that natural order, and will not be allowed to live.」

377:t_2:6.en:
$$正太郎$$
「I found you! You're the thief who stole my $$Ｖコン$$!」

377:t_2:7.en:
???
「$$金田正太郎$$... You did well to corner me here.」

377:t_2:10.en:
???
「Heh heh heh... $$マーズ$$ is here too, I see.」

377:t_2:11.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「How convenient. I shall declare war on you once again.」

377:t_2:12.en:
$$タケル$$
「$$ゲシュタルト$$! You're still alive!?」

377:t_2:13.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「With the power of darkness, I am an eternal being.」

377:t_2:14.en:
$$タケル$$
「If you're here... then $$皇帝ズール$$ is too!」

377:t_2:15.en:
$$正太郎$$
「What are you planning to do with $$鉄人$$'s stolen $$Ｖコン$$!?」

377:t_2:16.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「I have already achieved my aim. The power of the sun will soon cease to exist.」

377:t_2:18.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「Hahahahaha! I have no more use for that thing!」

377:t_2:19.en:
$n
「$$正太郎$$! Use the $$Ｖコン$$ to stop $$鉄人$$!」

377:t_2:20.en:
$$正太郎$$
「I-I can't! The solar energy converter has already gone out of control!」

377:t_2:21.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「Hahahahaha! If you don't want to die, you'd better run!」

377:t_3:5.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Yeah. I nearly turned $$鉄人$$ into a devil.」

377:t_3:6.en:
$$桂$$
「Still, who would've thought $$皇帝ズール$$ and $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ were alive and working together?」

377:t_3:7.en:
$$赤木$$
「They both seem to love darkness and all that stuff. I guess they hit it off.」
